verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Secretary of State offers online filings (annual reports, formation, closure) and an in-person counter, but nothing describes the sign-in or authentication method. There is no evidence of credential-based MFA, and none ruling out biometric liveness, mailed PINs, or in-person verification. Online-filing pages and a DOR portal shell that loads without content say nothing about how an authorized human authenticates.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
